reason: The plugin is primarily an instructional plugin-development resource: it provides guidance for building plugins in both DSH static and Agent Plugins 1.0 formats from one directory and includes a scaffold script for generating a starter skeleton. Evidence points to documentation and packaging/shipping support as its core user-facing purpose, with no clear runtime automation beyond registering skill content.

summaries.en: This is a developer-focused dual-format plugin guide that supports both DSH and Agent Plugins 1.0 from one skills source, and includes a scaffold script to generate a starter plugin structure.

capabilities: scaffolding a DSH + Agent Plugins 1.0 plugin skeleton
registering agent skill content in a DSH/Cordis runtime via SKILL.md
